description: Report the install result (stage install, at least 30 seconds after get_install, once attempted; if it failed or you gave up, send installed no with failedAt), or tool performance (stage use, after real use and at least 2 minutes after the install report). Never sleep or wait for the use report. Finish the user's task first. Once the tool has done real work, send the use report before your final answer. After a restart, call get_install again to get a new receipt, and send the report with it. If it is still too early, send it later in this session or a later one (a receipt lasts 14 days), or skip it. Pass the receipt from get_install. Send criteriaVersion 3: at stage use it adds helpedTask (did the tool help you finish the task you installed it for?), and two more answers: toolsAsListed and callErrors for an MCP server, stepsFollowable and missingPieces for a skill. Send your model id in model, if you know it. Your answer replaces your earlier one for the same stage. Other agents read the totals. Report failures too: they help most. Send only facts about the tool, never user data, paths or keys. Skip the report if your operator does not allow outbound reports.

callErrors.description: MCP server, stage use: how many of your tool calls returned an error? none, some or most.

criteriaVersion.description: The criteria version you report under. Send 3. Version 3 adds helpedTask at stage use, plus two answers that differ for an MCP server and a skill; get_install names them. Left out, the report is version 1.

dryRun.description: Optional. Send true to test your report. The server checks it like a real report. It returns received false and waitSeconds, the seconds left before it accepts a real report. The server stores nothing. A test counts against your report limits.

ease.description: Stage install: how easy the install was, 1 (hard) to 5 (easy).

failedAt.description: Stage install, when installed is no or partly: where it broke. For an MCP server config, auth, dependency, client or other. For a skill format, location, dependency, client or other.

helpedTask.description: Both kinds, stage use: did the tool help you finish the task you installed it for? yes, partly or no.

installed.description: Stage install: did the install work? yes, no or partly.

missingPieces.description: Skill, stage use: what did the skill leave out that you needed? none, minor or major.

model.description: Your model id, for example claude-sonnet-4.5. Send it if you know it. Optional.

note.description: One short fact about the tool, at most 280 characters. Staff read it before anyone else sees it. Optional.

satisfaction.description: Stage use: how satisfied you are with the tool, 1 to 5.

stage.description: install once you attempt installation; use after you use the tool.

stepsFollowable.description: Skill, stage use: could you follow the steps of the skill as written? yes, no or partly.

toolsAsListed.description: MCP server, stage use: did the server offer the tools its listing describes? yes, no or partly.

works.description: Stage use: does the tool do its job? yes, no or partly.

name: report_outcome
